items.title: Press Freedom Tracker year to date — 2026-11-12
items.summary: 262 incidents Jan 1 to Nov 12, 2026 excluding chilling statements (287 in the same span of 2025); latest incident dated 2026-11-10. By category: Assault 168, Arrest/Criminal Charge 46, Equipment Damage 32, Subpoena/Legal Order 25, Chilling Statement 21, Other Incident 14, Denial of Access 9, Equipment Search or Seizure 8, Leak Case 5, Prior Restraint 3, Border Stop 1.
